mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (type, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{type}, #{name}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT cr.chat_id, cr.type, cr.name, cr.last_message_id, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_participant cp1 ON cp1.chat_id = cr.chat_id AND cp1.user_id = #{userId1} AND cp1.left_at IS NULL JOIN chat_participant cp2 ON cp2.chat_id = cr.chat_id AND cp2.user_id = #{userId2} AND cp2.left_at IS NULL WHERE cr.type = 'PRIVATE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message_id = #{lastMessageId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE chat_id = #{chatId}
mapper.select: SELECT chat_id, type, name, last_message_id, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_room ORDER BY updated_at DESC
